0022600006.text: Both the Cleveland Cavaliers and Philadelphia 76ers are opening their 2026-27 seasons in this matchup, with the Cavaliers visiting as the away side. The Cavaliers are without Nae'Qwan Tomlin (out, back), while Khalifa Diop (knee) and Sam Merrill (elbow soreness) are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, and the 76ers are missing Ariel Hukporti (ruptured Achilles), Dean Wade (ankle sprain), Dominick Barlow (back) and Tacko Fall (hip), all listed as out. In 2025-26 the Cavaliers won the season series 4-0, and their most recent meeting was a 115-101 Cleveland win on March 9, 2026.
